tier_description: Delivery - 8-Axis critical evaluation + Quality Score post-implementation (Read-Only)

preflight_checks.description: REVIEW.md read (or its absence explicitly noted in the verdict) — review policy SSOT
Review target files and change intent are clearly identified
Paths and commands resolved via project-config.json or fallback
Test/lint/contract verification commands and obligatoriness classified
Test obligations recorded for doc-only, config-only, or behavior-altering code changes

postflight_checks.description: All axes executed according to Adaptive Depth
Mandatory commands, exit codes, and pass/fail counts reported
Quality Score computed using unified severity mathematics
Blocker findings ordered with file/line and evidentiary citations
Self-review bias, edge case, and Complexity ROI questions answered
On No-Go / Conditional Go, routing skills and re-verification commands explicitly specified in Next Actions per blocker (references/no-go-routing.md format)

outputs.description: 8-Axis critical review report + Quality Score (0-100) + Go/No-Go verdict
